market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. 4th consecutive S&P 500 decline with oil at $107, yields spiking, and VIX elevated. Trade war and Iran conflict create asymmetric downside. Expect volatility to persist through Q4 2026 unless oil stabilizes below $95. Oracle earnings will be critical catalyst.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle (Dell $95B backlog, MongoDB 91% RPO) supports tech earnings through 2027. However, 17% clean energy spending decline and BIS stability warnings suggest a correction is overdue. 6-12 month view: consolidation in tech, rotation to energy/industrials, then re-rating if inflation cools.
